purpose: Make continuous-operation doctrine executable at session/runtime boundaries so chat location does not determine institutional behavior.

chat_model.institutional_brain: Grant Front Office OS + sport adapter + canonical platform state + durable institutional context
chat_model.rule: HQ and specialist chats are peer workspaces; no chat is the sole source of truth.

bootstrap_sequence: Load the newest valid canonical platform state required by the question.
Recover relevant durable institutional context and settled decisions.

hard_gates.rule: Do not frame a player as an add, stash or waiver target until current league ownership is resolved from authoritative state.
Ownership, availability, roster placement, FAAB, picks, salary/cap and other deterministic platform facts must come from canonical or fresher platform evidence, not conversational memory.
Use platform IDs internally for identity and provenance; default user-facing output to names and decision-useful status rather than IDs or API plumbing.

evolution_loop.trigger: A material error repeats, a correction reveals a durable process gap, or a better workflow is discovered.
steps: Classify the lesson as shared or sport-specific.
Assign it to the existing responsible layer; do not create a parallel owner without need.
Encode the fix in code, contract or canonical derivation when deterministic.
Add or strengthen a regression check.
Propagate shared process changes through both sport adapters without copying sport-specific state.
Version/log the change and verify the relevant gate is GREEN.
evolution_loop.rule: A repeated operating failure is not considered fixed by memory alone.

GFO.availability_rule: Resolved Sleeper player absent from the current ownership index is AVAILABLE; present is ROSTERED.
GFO.waiver_rule: Waiver status affects acquisition timing, not availability; include clear time only when deterministically supported.
GFO.presentation: Keep Sleeper IDs and verification mechanics internal unless Grant asks.

GBO.rule: Apply the same bootstrap/evolution controls through CBS-specific ownership, availability, salary, cap, roster and transaction mechanics.
